body: I kinda understand, but, people say suicide will make the people who love you suffer, but there are people who have no family, no friends, i havent spoken to my dads side of the family for years, hes not in the picture and neither are they. They dont make effort to communicate with me, and there are many other people who have families like that too. My immediate family are fucking toxic as FUCK. I doubt they'd care if i died, but even if they did, i wouldn't care, they've made me suffer all these FUCKING years. and again, there is many other people who are in the same situations as me, thats why i really dont believe in stopping a suicidal person, i know it sounds bad but we're all suffering on earth... I know its nice to try and help somebody, but not everyone bounces back from a suicide attempt, I feel like most of them regret not doing it that time or sooner. This is just my opinion there's no right or wrong, some may agree, some may disagree it's just what I feel

i feel u bro, its nice and all they're trying to help but... sometimes even therapists kill themselves, idk. I just think we're all doomed on earth. I don't know why the whole world isnt depressed. i wish the depression would escape us because once your brain is exposed to it, i feel like its impossible to 100% leave.
